verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Pulumi serves a working llms.txt at https://www.pulumi.com/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with a project summary, and Pulumi also documents an official MCP server explicitly designed for AI assistants to consume Pulumi context/docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of broader agent-oriented docs pages (e.g. per-page .md endpoints, which probe shows 404) or independent confirmation of agents successfully using llms.txt in practice.
